title: An AI interface connects users to library collections
summary: Northeastern University Library linked Claude to its collections through a Model Context Protocol server and reported a better discovery experience in early testing; no source measures learning gains.
source_collection: University of Texas AI Opportunity Inventory
account: Northeastern University Library developed a Model Context Protocol server and a Claude plugin that direct academic requests to library resources and return links to the underlying works. Library dean Dan Cohen wrote on 10 October 2025 that until the month before he had found library materials only through index-based tools, which places the start of his use in September 2025. Cohen demonstrated the interface in October 2025. A later account described adding museum collections and retrieving relevant material without ordinary web search. In November 2025, Cohen and Evan Simpson reported an improved discovery experience in early testing. These accounts come from the deploying institution and include no controlled retrieval benchmark or measured learning outcome. On 27 August 2026 the Mellon Foundation announced a five-year, $5 million grant to HathiTrust with Northeastern University Library and Authors Alliance as partners, to build AI-assisted services for digitized books. Cohen cites the library's catalog and collection work as prior work for the grant.
purpose: The library built an AI interface to help users find scholarly and cultural materials while preserving access to source works.
system: Northeastern University Library MCP server and Claude plugin
segment: Discovery of scholarly and cultural collections
taxonomy_note: The reported result concerns discovery of materials. Learning gains and complete elimination of hallucinations are not established.
